invariants.rationale: commit likely requires a valid, non-null instant identifier.
partitionRecordsMap should not be null when committing, as it holds the data to commit.
commit is meaningful only if there are records to commit, i.e., the map should not be empty.
The instantTime identifier should be a non-empty string to represent a valid instant.
All partition keys in the map are expected to be valid, non-null, and non-empty strings.
